notes: All 14 discovery/diamond candidates were reviewed in this ranking pass. Only this assigned ranking file is written; every route and fee exclusion remains owned by the fee audit. Citation reach, acceptance selectivity, manuscript fit, current availability and fee eligibility are separate claims.

Difficulty bands are provisional agent judgments within the stated economics niche, never measured manuscript-specific odds or a cross-disciplinary prestige ladder. Three high bands (including historical closed EBL), one moderate band and ten unknown bands are retained. No venue was labelled easy from geographic focus, community sponsorship, absent metrics or absent JIF.

Eleven metric objects across six venues retain official values and exact years/periods: 7 citation metrics plus 4 acceptance metrics. PSE explicitly lacks a denominator definition; EKOIST’s 71 is the sum of tabulated accept/reject outcomes; EBL’s cumulative dispositions leave 3 received manuscripts unreconciled; Wiley’s denominator is the 2025 final-decision cohort. These rates are not directly interchangeable.

Year-qualified citation metrics use 2025 citation windows. The displayed venue pages do not supply raw citation/item counts, so population fields provide the metric definition rather than fabricate counts. Definitions were checked against the publisher’s official metrics guide. JIF, CiteScore, downloads and decision times did not determine difficulty.

Undated or conflicting RoEP figures and undated CEEJ citation figures were excluded from metrics rather than assigned guessed years. Missing metrics mean not verified in this bounded official-source search, not zero impact, no indexing or easy acceptance.

EBL remains closed from 2026-10-19 until further notice despite its documented fee-free policy and historical metrics. JCE’s prospective 2027 OUP description and staging portal remain unsuitable for an active November 2026 recommendation. Ranking patches do not override these availability/route restrictions.

Limitations: some official pages were blocked, restricted or timed out; PUCP policy evidence was search-indexed rather than a successful full-page retrieval. No third-party impact-factor aggregator, inferred fee, venue contact, account creation or manuscript submission was used. This is documentary agent research, not human scientific review.
